steps.what: Collect records for the functional specifications.
Fill the functional specification shell from records.
Draft prose for the hardware development process.

loop.input: The shell and its source records
loop.output: Process sentences that quote only those figures
loop.check: Each figure in the draft must equal a field in the shell
loop.stop: One draft; a figure with no field is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The process text is prose, and the figures are already fixed

steps.what: Issue the functional specification for hardware introduction.

tasks.design: Requirements and test records are fields on {DOCS}. A shell copies those figures into the functional specification, and a short draft writes the development-process sentences around them. The computer hardware engineer accepts that version before it is issued for hardware introduction, and a figure with no record is typed by hand and marked manual.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications were rewritten from old documents and mail each time hardware was introduced.
tasks.enabler_now: A shell can reuse figures that already exist. Deciding that the specification is fit to issue cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A sentence that sounds right but changes a limit.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which figure the factory will build to.

ambition.what: The engineer accepts or rejects a specification figure that does not trace to a record.

tasks.altitude: Drafting is shorter. The engineer still accepts the version that other people will build from.

reach.task: Trace a test result back to the specification it claims to meet
reach.learn: Which missing field makes them refuse a specification

evidence.claim: A specification can be filled from records, with prose drafted around those figures. Every number has to trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
The engineer who signs stays responsible for the design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from existing requirements and test records to one issued functional specification. The design work that created those records is out of scope.

Fields are requirement id, figure, unit, source record id and version. The record owner produces them. Fallback: the engineer types a figure and marks the source as manual, and that figure cannot be issued until they accept it.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 3.5 hours per 100 baseline hours is the shell and the source links.
unknowns: Who else must countersign before manufacturing starts.
Whether introduction packages already have a template.
research_questions: What share of figures in a specification are copied from an older one?
How often is an issued specification corrected in the first month?

incremental.description: Maintain the specification shell and source links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: most figures are still missing and the engineer writes the specification. High case: the shell is full and the engineer only accepts and issues one version.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Test hardware and record the results.

steps.what: Set up the hardware and support peripherals on the bench.
Record test data against each specification limit.
Compare each recorded value with its requirement.
Judge a fail the specification limit does not explain.
File the verification record for the hardware.

tasks.design: The bench setup stays with the computer hardware engineer. Test rows on a {SPREADSHEET} hold measurement, unit, limit and result, and a comparison on the {DATA_PLATFORM} marks only the rows that miss a numeric limit. A fail the limit does not explain stays a judgement, and the verification record is filed on {DOCS} for the team, not published.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results were typed twice, once on the bench sheet and once in the report.
tasks.enabler_now: A limit comparison can be repeated. The bench and the unexplained fail cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A result that meets the number and still fails in the product.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows when the setup, not the hardware, caused the miss.

ambition.what: The engineer decides whether a failed limit is a fault in the hardware or a bad setup.

tasks.altitude: Copying results is shorter. The bench and the fail judgement stay.

reach.task: Accept a verification record only when each result names its limit
reach.learn: Which missing field makes a record unusable

evidence.claim: A pass or fail against a numeric limit can be computed from the recorded value. A fail the limit does not explain stays with the engineer.
Requirements and verification status can be kept as records. That tracking does not choose the part or the design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from an issued specification to an internal verification record. A customer test report is out of scope.
Fields are measurement, value, unit, limit, pass or fail, tester and date. The engineer produces the value. Fallback: a row the form rejects is kept on the bench sheet and typed later.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours is the measurement form.
unknowns: Whether instruments can already write a row without retyping.
Who may see a failed result outside the team.
research_questions: What share of fails are setup errors?
How many results are still copied by hand?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: most time is the bench and odd failures. High case: limit checks are repeated and only the unexplained fails stay. The setup stays either way.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Hear the technician's status before directing the work.
Direct technicians, engineering designers and support personnel.
Technician carries out the directed bench work.
Post the work order the technician will follow.

tasks.design: Directing technicians and engineering designers stays a conversation. A work order on {PROJECT} holds the task, the bench and the due time after the computer hardware engineer has already given the direction. The technician's bench time is their own and is not a saving for the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Directions were repeated because the last instruction lived in a chat line.
tasks.enabler_now: A work order can repeat a direction already given. Supervision cannot be replaced by the list.
tasks.still_hard: Changing the instruction when the bench is not what the engineer expected.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sees when a technician is stuck and the written order is wrong.
tasks.altitude: The conversation stays. A posted order means the same direction is not retyped. The engineer's week is almost unchanged.

reach.role: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
reach.task: Carry out a bench task from a written work order
reach.learn: Which orders they cannot follow without a conversation

evidence.claim: Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from a status conversation to a direction and a work order. Doing the bench work is the technician's task.
Fields are task, bench, part and due time. The engineer writes them after the conversation. Fallback: the order is a note in the same conversation.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours is the work-order fields.
unknowns: Whether technicians already work from a queue.
How often a direction changes the same day.
research_questions: What share of directions are repeats of yesterday?
Do technicians stop work when the order and the conversation disagree?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: every direction is a new conversation and the order adds time. High case: repeat directions are posted once. The conversation stays either way.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the technical support question and the specification.
Talk with designers, marketing and sales about the question.
Draft a support answer from the approved specification.

loop.input: The question and the issued specification
loop.output: An answer that cites a specification section
loop.check: Every claim cites a section; otherwise the sentence is cut
loop.stop: One draft, then the engineer rewrites
loop.why_not_simpler: The question is free text and the allowed facts are already in the specification

steps.what: Check the support answer before it leaves the team.
Send the checked support answer to the supplier.

tasks.design: Questions are read against the issued specification on {DOCS}. The conversation with designers, marketing and sales stays. A draft may only cite that specification, and the computer hardware engineer checks it before {EMAIL} sends it to a supplier. Advice that is not in the specification is written by the engineer or not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Answers were retyped from memory and sometimes left the team unchecked.
tasks.enabler_now: A citation check can be repeated. The conversation and the decision to send cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A supplier question that is really a change to the design.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows when an answer would promise something the board does not do.

ambition.what: A written answer a supplier can reuse without a second call.

tasks.altitude: Repeat questions take less rewriting. The engineer still talks to sales and still releases anything that leaves the team.

reach.task: Ask what a hardware limit means for the line
reach.learn: Which answers they treat as a process change rather than a fact

evidence.claim: A specification can be filled from records, with prose drafted around those figures. Every number has to trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from a support question to one checked answer. Changing the specification is out of scope.
Fields are question id, asker, product, specification version and cited section. The asker writes the question. Fallback: the engineer writes the answer with no draft.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2.5 hours per 100 baseline hours is the citation list.
unknowns: Which suppliers may receive an answer without a meeting.
Whether sales is allowed to forward an answer.
research_questions: What share of questions are repeats?
How often does an answer become a specification change?

incremental.description: Maintain the citation list for support answers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: most questions need a meeting and a new judgement. High case: the specification already answers it and the engineer only checks the citation before the send.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specification issue and bench verification stay the engineer's decision. Repeat typing shrinks. Directing technicians is still a conversation.
reach: Validation Engineers, on which missing field makes a record useless.
Manufacturing Engineers, on what they need before they will build from a specification.
skills_to_grow: Refusing a figure that has no source record.
Separating a bad setup from a failed board.
role.ambitious_version: A supplier can reuse a checked answer, and the factory builds from a specification whose figures each name a record.
